study_identification_part.si4_title: Brain charts for the human lifespan

answer: Aggregated reference MRI dataset spanning >100 primary studies (123,984 scans from 101,457 participants; mid-gestation to 100 years)

Example cohorts in the reference control set: ABCD, ABIDE1/2, ADHD200, ADNI, AIBL, AOBA, AOMIC_ID1000/PIOP1/PIOP2, ARWIBO, ASRB, BabyConnectome, BGSP, and many additional studies listed in Supplementary Table 1.2
Clinical case datasets across multiple diagnostic categories used for centile comparisons
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Reference dataset aggregated across lifespan to build normative brain charts; diverse clinical cohorts included to evaluate centile deviations across disorders (see Supplementary Information 10 for diagnostic group comparisons).

answer.reference_control_dataset: normative training of sex-stratified GAMLSS growth curves across the lifespan
answer.clinical_case_sets: case-control and cross-disorder centile comparisons and CMD summaries

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Controls from 100 studies formed the reference dataset for estimating normative trajectories; the clinical diversity of the aggregated dataset was leveraged to benchmark centile deviations and CMD across diagnostic groups (Fig. 4, Supplementary Information 10).
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "We used GAMLSS to estimate cross-sectional normative age-related trends from 100 studies, comprising a reference dataset of more than 100,000 scans" / "The clinical diversity of the aggregated dataset enabled us to comprehensively investigate case-control differences in individually specific centile scores across a range of conditions."
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: study_1/Bethlehem2021.pdf.md: Model generation and specification; study_1/Bethlehem2021.pdf.md: Case-control differences section

dc3_number_of_healthy_control.detail: Totals for the GMV normative control sample (female 38,839; male 38,318; sum 77,157) computed by summing the Sample size column across studies in Supplementary Table 1.2. No separate train/validation split was reported for the cross-sectional reference dataset.

dc4_age_info.detail: Weighted mean age calculated from the 'Mean Age (in days)' column multiplied by Sample size (Supplementary Table 1.2) and converted to years; minimum and maximum ages taken from the 'Minimum age (in days)' and 'Maximum age (in days)' columns. No train/test split reported.
